svg.title: K-nearest neighbours regressor
svg.desc: A k-nearest neighbours regressor has no fitted structure: the model is its stored reference rows, on the standardised scale, coloured by quarter of their target. A new row is predicted as the average target of the 15 nearest of them. The axes are the two principal components of the stored rows: the first is led by amount +0.7, velocity +0.7, merchant_risk -0.09; the second is led by account_age +0.7, merchant_risk -0.7, velocity -0.09.
svg.text: 144 stored reference rows in target quarters, k = 15
